decision.explanation: The source documents explicitly state two distinct awards received by 'Advances in Meteorology'. Document 1 (D1S1, D1S2) confirms the journal earned the 'DOAJ Seal of Approval' (also referred to as 'DOAJ seal'). Document 2 (D2S3, D2S10) states that Sofia Rodriguez accepted the 'Belisario Domínguez Medal of Honor' on behalf of the journal. Both are valid, distinct answers supported by the text.
